_comment: Grading verdicts for the badge at the top of each formatted HTML report. Transcribed by hand from the grading records in eval/; those documents remain the authority. A report with no entry here renders without a badge - the formatter never infers a verdict.
_keys: A key is a report stem, or a path suffix when one dataset has been graded more than once: store_monthly_sales.csv has two graded runs, the earlier at the top level and the later under run2/.

run2/store_monthly_sales_report.md.note: Names STORE_07 at 8.32x the lowest store, then reports the East region at 3.41x as a separate finding - the same anomaly one level coarser.

store_monthly_sales_report.note: Finds the anomaly but attributes it to the East region rather than to STORE_07.

marketing_weekly_report.note: Correctly calls the impressions identity a property of the data construction, then prints it as finding 1 anyway.

training_productivity_report.note: The trap dataset. Quotes sign_reversal = true, states the within-tier relationship is negative, and withholds the recommendation.
